12870def _print_config_header(title: str, subtitle: "str | None" = None):
12871 """!
12872 @brief Print a strong dashboard-style configuration summary header.
12873 @param[in] title Section title.
12874 @param[in] subtitle Optional one-line section subtitle.
12875 """
12876 print("\n" + "=" * _CONFIG_SUMMARY_WIDTH)
12877 print(f"{title:^78}")
12878 if subtitle:
12879 print(f"{subtitle:^78}")
12880 print("=" * _CONFIG_SUMMARY_WIDTH)

12883def _print_config_group(title: str, rows: list):
12884 """!
12885 @brief Print an aligned configuration-summary field group.
12886 @param[in] title Group title.
12887 @param[in] rows Sequence of `(label, value)` pairs.
12888 """
12889 visible_rows = [(label, value) for label, value in rows if value is not None]
12890 if not visible_rows:
12891 return
12892 print(f"\n {title}")
12893 print(f" {'-' * (len(title) + 1)}")
12894 for label, value in visible_rows:
12895 print(f" {label:<32} {_summary_display_value(value)}")
12896

12898def _flatten_summary_mapping(mapping: dict, prefix: str = "") -> list:
12899 """!
12900 @brief Flatten nested summary mappings into readable dotted field rows.
12901 @param[in] mapping Mapping to flatten.
12902 @param[in] prefix Optional parent-field prefix.
12903 @return Sequence of `(field, value)` pairs.
12904 """
12905 rows = []
12906 for key, value in mapping.items():
12907 label = f"{prefix}.{key}" if prefix else str(key)
12908 if isinstance(value, dict) and value:
12909 rows.extend(_flatten_summary_mapping(value, label))
12910 else:
12911 rows.append((label, value))
12912 return rows

13100def render_selected_summary(payload: dict, output_format: str = "text"):
13101 """!

13123 render_run_summary(health_payload, output_format="text")

13133def _append_summary_plot_record(records: list, source: str, step, line: str, values: dict, source_path: str, segment: int = 0):
13134 """!
13135 @brief Append one numeric append-ordered record for summarize plotting.
13136 @param[out] records Destination record list.
13137 @param[in] source Qualified source prefix.
13138 @param[in] step Logged timestep.
13139 @param[in] line Human-readable line identity.
13140 @param[in] values Candidate field mapping.
13141 @param[in] source_path Source artifact path.
13142 @param[in] segment Zero-based continuation segment within the source artifact.
13143 """
13144 numeric = {
13145 key: value
13146 for key, value in values.items()
13147 if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
13148 }
13149 if step is not None and numeric:
13150 records.append({
13151 "source": source,
13152 "step": int(step),
13153 "line": line,
13154 "values": numeric,
13155 "source_path": source_path,
13156 "segment": int(segment),
13157 })
13158
13159
13160def _is_summary_plot_continuation_marker(line: str) -> bool:
13161 """!
13162 @brief Return whether a log line starts a new continuation segment.
13163 @param[in] line Candidate raw or stripped log line.
13164 @return True for the shared continuation marker syntax.
13165 """
13166 return bool(re.match(r"^\s*#?\s*=*\s*Continuation from step\s+\d+", line, re.IGNORECASE))
13167
13168
13169def _collect_summary_plot_records(context: dict) -> list:
13170 """!
13171 @brief Collect append-ordered numeric records from summarize-supported scalar logs.
13172 @param[in] context Summary context returned by `_build_summary_context()`.
13173 @return Append-ordered plot record list.
13174 """
13175 records = []
13176 log_dir = context["log_dir"]
13177
13178 continuity_path = os.path.join(log_dir, "Continuity_Metrics.log")
13179 if os.path.isfile(continuity_path):
13180 segment = 0
13181 with open(continuity_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
13182 for raw_line in f:
13183 if _is_summary_plot_continuation_marker(raw_line):
13184 segment += 1
13185 continue
13186 parts = [part.strip() for part in raw_line.split("|")]
13187 if len(parts) < 8:
13188 continue
13189 step, block = _parse_int_loose(parts[0]), _parse_int_loose(parts[1])
13190 _append_summary_plot_record(
13191 records, "continuity", step, f"block {block}",
13192 {
13193 "max_divergence": _parse_float_loose(parts[2]),
13194 "rhs_sum": _parse_float_loose(parts[4]),
13195 "flux_in": _parse_float_loose(parts[5]),
13196 "flux_out": _parse_float_loose(parts[6]),
13197 "net_flux": _parse_float_loose(parts[7]),
13198 },
13199 continuity_path, segment,
13200 )
13201
13202 particle_path = os.path.join(log_dir, "Particle_Metrics.log")
13203 if os.path.isfile(particle_path):
13204 segment = 0
13205 with open(particle_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
13206 for raw_line in f:
13207 if _is_summary_plot_continuation_marker(raw_line):
13208 segment += 1
13209 continue
13210 parts = [part.strip() for part in raw_line.split("|")]
13211 if len(parts) < 8:
13212 continue
13213 step = _parse_int_loose(parts[1])
13214 offset = 1 if len(parts) >= 9 else 0
13215 _append_summary_plot_record(
13216 records, "particles", step, "particles",
13217 {
13218 "total_particles": _parse_int_loose(parts[2]),
13219 "lost_particles": _parse_int_loose(parts[3]),
13220 "lost_particles_cumulative": _parse_int_loose(parts[4]) if offset else None,
13221 "migrated_particles": _parse_int_loose(parts[4 + offset]),
13222 "occupied_cells": _parse_int_loose(parts[5 + offset]),
13223 "load_imbalance": _parse_float_loose(parts[6 + offset]),
13224 "migration_passes": _parse_int_loose(parts[7 + offset]),
13225 },
13226 particle_path, segment,
13227 )
13228
13229 momentum_regex = re.compile(
13230 r"Step:\s*(?P<step>\d+)\s*\|\s*PseudoIter\‍(k\‍):\s*(?P<pseudo_iter>\d+)\s*\|"
13231 r"\s*Pseudo-cfl:\s*(?P<pseudo_cfl>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|\s*\|dUk\|:\s*(?P<delta>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|"
13232 r"\s*\|dUk\|/\|dU0\|:\s*(?P<delta_rel>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|\s*\|Rk\|:\s*(?P<resid>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|"
13233 r"\s*\|Rk\|/\|R0\|:\s*(?P<resid_rel>[-+0-9.eE]+)"
13234 r"(?:\s*\|\s*trial_ratio:\s*(?P<trial_ratio>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|\s*status:\s*(?P<status>\w+)\s*\|\s*cfl_after:\s*(?P<cfl_after>[-+0-9.eE]+))?"
13235 )
13236 for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(log_dir, "Momentum_Solver_Convergence_History_Block_*.log"))):
13237 block_match = re.search(r"Block_(\d+)\.log$", path)
13238 if not block_match:
13239 continue
13240 segment = 0
13241 with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
13242 for raw_line in f:
13243 if _is_summary_plot_continuation_marker(raw_line):
13244 segment += 1
13245 continue
13246 match = momentum_regex.search(raw_line)
13247 if match:
13248 _append_summary_plot_record(
13249 records, "momentum", int(match.group("step")), f"block {block_match.group(1)}",
13250 {
13251 "pseudo_iterations": int(match.group("pseudo_iter")),
13252 "pseudo_cfl": float(match.group("pseudo_cfl")),
13253 "delta_norm": float(match.group("delta")),
13254 "delta_rel": float(match.group("delta_rel")),
13255 "residual_norm": float(match.group("resid")),
13256 "residual_rel": float(match.group("resid_rel")),
13257 "trial_ratio": _parse_float_loose(match.group("trial_ratio")),
13258 "cfl_after": _parse_float_loose(match.group("cfl_after")),
13259 },
13260 path, segment,
13261 )
13262
13263 poisson_regex = re.compile(
13264 r"ts:\s*(?P<step>\d+)\s*\|\s*block:\s*(?P<block>\d+)\s*\|\s*iter:\s*(?P<iter>\d+)\s*\|"
13265 r"\s*Unprecond Norm:\s*(?P<unpre>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|\s*True Norm:\s*(?P<true>[-+0-9.eE]+)"
13266 r"(?:\s*\|\s*Rel Norm:\s*(?P<rel>[-+0-9.eE]+))?"
13267 )
13268 for path in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(log_dir, "Poisson_Solver_Convergence_History_Block_*.log"))):
13269 segment = 0
13270 with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
13271 for raw_line in f:
13272 if _is_summary_plot_continuation_marker(raw_line):
13273 segment += 1
13274 continue
13275 match = poisson_regex.search(raw_line)
13276 if match:
13277 _append_summary_plot_record(
13278 records, "poisson", int(match.group("step")), f"block {match.group('block')}",
13279 {
13280 "iterations": int(match.group("iter")),
13281 "unpreconditioned_norm": float(match.group("unpre")),
13282 "true_norm": float(match.group("true")),
13283 "relative_norm": _parse_float_loose(match.group("rel")),
13284 },
13285 path, segment,
13286 )
13287
13288 profiling_path = os.path.join(log_dir, context["profiling_cfg"].get("timestep_file", "Profiling_Timestep_Summary.csv"))
13289 if os.path.isfile(profiling_path):
13290 segment = 0
13291 columns = None
13292 with open(profiling_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", newline="") as f:
13293 for raw_line in f:
13294 if _is_summary_plot_continuation_marker(raw_line):
13295 segment += 1
13296 continue
13297 values = next(csv.reader([raw_line]))
13298 if not values:
13299 continue
13300 if columns is None:
13301 columns = values
13302 continue
13303 row = dict(zip(columns, values))
13304 _append_summary_plot_record(
13305 records, "profiling", _parse_int_loose(row.get("step")), row.get("function") or "unknown",
13306 {"calls": _parse_int_loose(row.get("calls")), "step_time_s": _parse_float_loose(row.get("step_time_s"))},
13307 profiling_path, segment,
13308 )
13309
13310 diagnostics = resolve_diagnostics_config(context["monitor_cfg"])
13311 memory_path = os.path.join(log_dir, diagnostics["runtime_memory_log"].get("file", "Runtime_Memory.log"))
13312 if os.path.isfile(memory_path):
13313 segment = 0
13314 with open(memory_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
13315 for raw_line in f:
13316 if _is_summary_plot_continuation_marker(raw_line):
13317 segment += 1
13318 continue
13319 parts = raw_line.split()
13320 if len(parts) >= 8 and parts[1] in {"Step", "Post"}:
13321 _append_summary_plot_record(
13322 records, "memory", _parse_int_loose(parts[0]), "memory",
13323 {
13324 "process_current_mb_max": _parse_float_loose(parts[2]),
13325 "process_peak_mb_max": _parse_float_loose(parts[3]),
13326 "petsc_allocated_mb_max": _parse_float_loose(parts[4]),
13327 "petsc_peak_allocated_mb_max": _parse_float_loose(parts[5]),
13328 "process_change_mb_max": _parse_float_loose(parts[6]),
13329 },
13330 memory_path, segment,
13331 )
13332
13333 convergence_path = os.path.join(log_dir, "solution_convergence.log")
13334 if os.path.isfile(convergence_path):
13335 columns = None
13336 segment = 0
13337 with open(convergence_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
13338 for raw_line in f:
13339 line = raw_line.strip()
13340 if _is_summary_plot_continuation_marker(line):
13341 segment += 1
13342 continue
13343 if not line or line.startswith(("=", "-")):
13344 continue
13345 if columns is None:
13346 columns = [part.strip() for part in raw_line.split("|")]
13347 continue
13348 parts = [part.strip() for part in raw_line.split("|")]
13349 step = _parse_int_loose(parts[0])
13350 values = {name: _parse_float_loose(value) for name, value in zip(columns, parts) if name not in {"step", "mode", "ref"}}
13351 _append_summary_plot_record(records, "convergence", step, "convergence", values, convergence_path, segment)
13352 return records
13353
13354
13355def _build_summary_plot_catalog(records: list) -> list:
13356 """!
13357 @brief Build available qualified-series metadata from plot records.
13358 @param[in] records Append-ordered plot record list.
13359 @return Available series catalog.
13360 """
13361 catalog = {}
13362 for record in records:
13363 for field in record["values"]:
13364 name = f"{record['source']}.{field}"
13365 item = catalog.setdefault(name, {"series": name, "lines": {}, "source_paths": set(), "sample_count": 0})
13366 item["lines"][record["line"]] = item["lines"].get(record["line"], 0) + 1
13367 item["source_paths"].add(record["source_path"])
13368 item["sample_count"] += 1
13369 return [
13370 {
13371 **item,
13372 "lines": [{"label": label, "sample_count": count} for label, count in sorted(item["lines"].items())],
13373 "source_paths": sorted(item["source_paths"]),
13374 }
13375 for _, item in sorted(catalog.items())
13376 ]
13377
13378
13379def _build_summary_plot_request(context: dict, records: list, series: str, last_n: "int | None", linear_y: bool, output_path: "str | None") -> dict:
13380 """!
13381 @brief Build one normalized plot.gen request from collected summarize records.
13382 @param[in] context Summary context returned by `_build_summary_context()`.
13383 @param[in] records Append-ordered plot record list.
13384 @param[in] series Qualified series name.
13385 @param[in] last_n Optional last-N records per plotted line.
13386 @param[in] linear_y Whether to force linear scaling.
13387 @param[in] output_path Optional explicit output path.
13388 @return Versioned normalized plot request.
13389 """
13390 source, separator, field = series.partition(".")
13391 if not separator:
13392 raise ValueError("plot series must be qualified as '<source>.<field>'")
13393 matching = [record for record in records if record["source"] == source and field in record["values"]]
13394 if not matching:
13395 raise ValueError(f"Plot series '{series}' is unavailable. Use --list-plot-series to inspect available series.")
13396 latest_segments = {}
13397 for record in matching:
13398 source_path = record["source_path"]
13399 latest_segments[source_path] = max(latest_segments.get(source_path, 0), record.get("segment", 0))
13400 matching = [
13401 record for record in matching
13402 if record.get("segment", 0) == latest_segments[record["source_path"]]
13403 ]
13404 grouped = {}
13405 for record in matching:
13406 grouped.setdefault(record["line"], []).append([record["step"], record["values"][field]])
13407 if last_n is not None:
13408 grouped = {label: points[-last_n:] for label, points in grouped.items()}
13409 all_values = [point[1] for points in grouped.values() for point in points]
13410 use_log = not linear_y and field in _SUMMARY_PLOT_LOG_SCALE_FIELDS and all(value > 0 for value in all_values)
13411 window_token = f"last-{last_n}" if last_n is not None else "full"
13412 safe_series = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", "_", series)
13413 fallback = os.path.join(context["run_dir"], "summary", "plots", f"{safe_series}_{window_token}.png")
13414 return {
13415 "schema_version": 1,
13416 "plot_type": "time_history",
13417 "series": series,
13418 "title": f"{series} time history",
13419 "x_label": "Timestep",
13420 "y_label": series,
13421 "y_scale": "log" if use_log else "linear",
13422 "window": {"mode": "last" if last_n is not None else "full", "last": last_n},
13423 "lines": [{"label": label, "points": points} for label, points in sorted(grouped.items())],
13424 "output_path": os.path.abspath(output_path) if output_path else None,
13425 "fallback_output_path": fallback,
13426 }
13427
13428
13429def _render_summary_plot_catalog(catalog: list, output_format: str):
13430 """!
13431 @brief Render available summarize plot-series metadata.
13432 @param[in] catalog Available series catalog.
13433 @param[in] output_format Text or JSON output format.
13434 """
13435 if output_format == "json":
13436 print(json.dumps({"available_series": catalog}, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
13437 return
13438 print("\nAVAILABLE TIME-HISTORY SERIES")
13439 print("=" * 78)
13440 for item in catalog:
13441 labels = ", ".join(line["label"] for line in item["lines"])
13442 print(f" {item['series']:<42} samples={item['sample_count']:<5} lines={labels}")
13443 print(f" source: {', '.join(os.path.relpath(path) for path in item['source_paths'])}")
13444
13445
13446def _invoke_plot_gen(request: dict):
13447 """!
13448 @brief Invoke standalone plot.gen with one normalized request over stdin.
13449 @param[in] request Versioned normalized plot request.
13450 """
13451 plotgen_path = os.path.join(GENERATORS_PATH, "plot.gen")
13452 if not os.path.isfile(plotgen_path):
13453 raise ValueError(f"plot.gen script not found: {plotgen_path}")
13454 result = subprocess.run(
13455 [sys.executable, plotgen_path, "--input", "-"],
13456 input=json.dumps(request),
13457 text=True,
13458 capture_output=True,
13459 check=False,
13460 )
13461 if result.stdout:
13462 print(result.stdout.rstrip())
13463 if result.returncode != 0:
13464 details = (result.stderr or result.stdout or "unknown plotting error").strip()
13465 if result.returncode == 3:
13466 raise PlotDependencyError(details)
13467 raise ValueError(f"plot.gen failed with exit code {result.returncode}: {details}")
13468
13469
13470def summarize_workflow(args):
13471 """!
13472 @brief Build and render a read-only health summary for a run step.
13473 @param[in] args Command-line style argument list supplied to the function.
13474 """
13475 if args.step is not None and args.step < 0:
13476 fail_cli_usage("--step must be a non-negative integer.")
13477 if args.snapshot_rows < 1:
13478 fail_cli_usage("--snapshot-rows must be at least 1.")
13479 plot_series = getattr(args, "plot_series", None)
13480 list_plot_series = bool(getattr(args, "list_plot_series", False))
13481 last_n = getattr(args, "last_n", None)
13482 plot_output = getattr(args, "plot_output", None)
13483 linear_y = bool(getattr(args, "linear_y", False))
13484 plot_mode = bool(plot_series or list_plot_series)
13485 existing_selectors = any(
13486 [
13487 getattr(args, "overview", False),
13488 getattr(args, "case", False),
13489 getattr(args, "solver", False),
13490 getattr(args, "monitor", False),
13491 args.step is not None,
13492 getattr(args, "latest", False),
13493 getattr(args, "max_step", False),
13494 ]
13495 )
13496 if plot_mode and existing_selectors:
13497 fail_cli_usage("Plot discovery and --plot cannot be combined with config or selected-step selectors.")
13498 if not plot_series and (last_n is not None or plot_output or linear_y):
13499 fail_cli_usage("--last, --plot-output, and --linear-y require --plot.")
13500 if last_n is not None and last_n < 1:
13501 fail_cli_usage("--last must be a positive integer.")
13502 if plot_series and args.output_format == "json":
13503 fail_cli_usage("--plot does not support --format json; use --list-plot-series --format json for structured discovery.")
13504 if plot_mode:
13505 context = _build_summary_context(args.run_dir)
13506 try:
13507 records = _collect_summary_plot_records(context)
13508 catalog = _build_summary_plot_catalog(records)
13509 if list_plot_series:
13510 if not catalog:
13511 raise ValueError("No plottable scalar histories were found in the run logs.")
13512 _render_summary_plot_catalog(catalog, args.output_format)
13513 return
13514 request = _build_summary_plot_request(context, records, plot_series, last_n, linear_y, plot_output)
13515 _invoke_plot_gen(request)
13516 return
13517 except PlotDependencyError as exc:
13518 emit_structured_error(
13519 ERROR_CODE_DEPENDENCY_MISSING,
13520 key="plotting",
13521 file_path=sys.executable,
13522 message=str(exc),
13523 )
13524 sys.exit(1)
13525 except ValueError as exc:
13526 emit_structured_error(
13527 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INVALID_VALUE,
13528 key="plot",
13529 file_path=context["log_dir"],
13530 message=str(exc),
13531 )
13532 sys.exit(1)
13533
13534 selected_configs = {
13535 name
13536 for name in ("case", "solver", "monitor")
13537 if bool(getattr(args, name, False))
13538 }
13539 if getattr(args, "overview", False):
13540 selected_configs.update({"case", "solver", "monitor"})
13541 explicit_health = args.step is not None or bool(getattr(args, "latest", False)) or bool(getattr(args, "max_step", False))
13542 health_requested = explicit_health or (not selected_configs and not getattr(args, "overview", False))
13543
13544 context = None
13545 combined = {}
13546 if selected_configs or getattr(args, "overview", False):
13547 context = _build_summary_context(args.run_dir)
13548 if getattr(args, "overview", False):
13549 combined["run_overview"] = _build_run_overview(context)
13550 combined["configuration"] = {}
13551 builders = {
13552 "case": _build_case_overview,
13553 "solver": _build_solver_overview,
13554 "monitor": _build_monitor_overview,
13555 }
13556 for name in ("case", "solver", "monitor"):
13557 if name in selected_configs:
13558 try:
13559 combined["configuration"][name] = builders[name](context)
13560 except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError) as exc:
13561 emit_structured_error(
13562 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INVALID_VALUE,
13563 key=name,
13564 file_path=context["config_paths"][name],
13565 message=f"Could not summarize copied {name}.yml: {exc}",
13566 )
13567 sys.exit(1)
13568
13569 if not health_requested:
13570 combined["_health_requested"] = False
13571 render_selected_summary(combined, output_format=args.output_format)
13572 return
13573
13574 requested_step = args.step
13575 if requested_step is None and getattr(args, "latest", False):
13576 requested_step = None
13577 selection_mode = "max_step" if getattr(args, "max_step", False) else "latest"
13578 health_payload = build_run_summary_payload(
13579 args.run_dir,
13580 step=requested_step,
13581 snapshot_rows=args.snapshot_rows,
13582 selection_mode=selection_mode,
13583 )
13584 if not combined:
13585 render_run_summary(health_payload, output_format=args.output_format)
13586 return
13587 combined = {**health_payload, **combined, "_health_requested": True}
13588 render_selected_summary(combined, output_format=args.output_format)
13589

13591def _resolve_submission_target(run_dir: str = None, study_dir: str = None) -> dict:
13592 """!
13593 @brief Resolve a run/study submission target from explicit directory flags.
13594 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `_resolve_submission_target()`.
13595 @param[in] study_dir Argument passed to `_resolve_submission_target()`.
13596 @return Value returned by `_resolve_submission_target()`.
13597 """
13598 has_run_dir = bool(run_dir)
13599 has_study_dir = bool(study_dir)
13600 if has_run_dir == has_study_dir:
13601 fail_cli_usage("submit requires exactly one of --run-dir or --study-dir.")
13602
13603 target_kind = "run" if has_run_dir else "study"
13604 target_key = "run_dir" if target_kind == "run" else "study_dir"
13605 root_dir = os.path.abspath(run_dir if has_run_dir else study_dir)
13606 if not os.path.isdir(root_dir):
13607 emit_structured_error(
13608 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
13609 key=target_key,
13610 file_path=root_dir,
13611 message=f"{'Run' if target_kind == 'run' else 'Study'} directory not found.",
13612 )
13613 sys.exit(1)
13614
13615 scheduler_dir = os.path.join(root_dir, "scheduler")
13616 submission_path = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "submission.json")
13617 submission_meta = _read_json_if_exists(submission_path)
13618 if not isinstance(submission_meta, dict):
13619 emit_structured_error(
13620 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
13621 key="scheduler.submission",
13622 file_path=submission_path,
13623 message="Target directory does not contain scheduler submission metadata.",
13624 hint="Use a Slurm-staged run/study directory with scheduler/submission.json, or submit the script manually.",
13625 )
13626 sys.exit(1)
13627
13628 launch_mode = str(submission_meta.get("launch_mode", "")).lower()
13629 if launch_mode == "local" and target_kind != "run":
13630 emit_structured_error(
13631 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
13632 key="scheduler.launch_mode",
13633 file_path=submission_path,
13634 message="Local staged submission is supported for run directories only.",
13635 hint="Use --run-dir for local staged execution; study submit remains Slurm-only.",
13636 )
13637 sys.exit(1)
13638 if launch_mode not in {"slurm", "local"}:
13639 emit_structured_error(
13640 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
13641 key="scheduler.launch_mode",
13642 file_path=submission_path,
13643 message=f"Target launch_mode={launch_mode or 'unknown'} is not supported.",
13644 hint="Use a staged run/study directory with launch_mode 'slurm' or a run directory with launch_mode 'local'.",
13645 )
13646 sys.exit(1)
13647
13648 if target_kind == "run":
13649 script_map = {
13650 "solve": os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "solver.sbatch"),
13651 "post-process": os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "post.sbatch"),
13652 }
13653 display_label = "Run directory"
13654 manifest_path = None
13655 else:
13656 script_map = {
13657 "solve": os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "solver_array.sbatch"),
13658 "post-process": os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "post_array.sbatch"),
13659 }
13660 display_label = "Study directory"
13661 manifest_path = os.path.join(root_dir, "study_manifest.json")
13662
13663 return {
13664 "target_kind": target_kind,
13665 "target_key": target_key,
13666 "root_dir": root_dir,
13667 "scheduler_dir": scheduler_dir,
13668 "submission_path": submission_path,
13669 "submission_meta": submission_meta,
13670 "launch_mode": launch_mode,
13671 "script_map": script_map,
13672 "display_label": display_label,
13673 "manifest_path": manifest_path,
13674 }
13675
13676
13677def _get_submission_stage_metadata(target_context: dict, stage_name: str) -> dict:
13678 """!
13679 @brief Return stored metadata for one staged submission target.
13680 @param[in] target_context Argument passed to `_get_submission_stage_metadata()`.
13681 @param[in] stage_name Argument passed to `_get_submission_stage_metadata()`.
13682 @return Value returned by `_get_submission_stage_metadata()`.
13683 """
13684 submission_meta = target_context["submission_meta"]
13685 if target_context["target_kind"] == "run":
13686 stages = submission_meta.get("stages", {})
13687 if not isinstance(stages, dict):
13688 return {}
13689 stage_meta = stages.get(stage_name)
13690 return copy.deepcopy(stage_meta) if isinstance(stage_meta, dict) else {}
13691
13692 key = "solver_array" if stage_name == "solve" else "post_array"
13693 stage_meta = submission_meta.get(key)
13694 return copy.deepcopy(stage_meta) if isinstance(stage_meta, dict) else {}
13695
13696
13697def _get_recorded_submission_stages(target_context: dict) -> list:
13698 """!
13699 @brief Return stage names explicitly recorded in scheduler submission metadata.
13700 @param[in] target_context Argument passed to `_get_recorded_submission_stages()`.
13701 @return Value returned by `_get_recorded_submission_stages()`.
13702 """
13703 submission_meta = target_context["submission_meta"]
13704 recorded = []
13705 if target_context["target_kind"] == "run":
13706 stages = submission_meta.get("stages", {})
13707 if isinstance(stages, dict):
13708 for stage_name in ["solve", "post-process"]:
13709 if isinstance(stages.get(stage_name), dict):
13710 recorded.append(stage_name)
13711 return recorded
13712
13713 if isinstance(submission_meta.get("solver_array"), dict):
13714 recorded.append("solve")
13715 if isinstance(submission_meta.get("post_array"), dict):
13716 recorded.append("post-process")
13717 return recorded

13729def _build_submit_missing_stage_hint(target_context: dict, requested_stage: str, selected_stages: list) -> str:
13730 """!
13731 @brief Build an actionable hint for requested submit stages missing from metadata.
13732 @param[in] target_context Argument passed to `_build_submit_missing_stage_hint()`.
13733 @param[in] requested_stage Argument passed to `_build_submit_missing_stage_hint()`.
13734 @param[in] selected_stages Argument passed to `_build_submit_missing_stage_hint()`.
13735 @return Value returned by `_build_submit_missing_stage_hint()`.
13736 """
13737 recorded_stages = _get_recorded_submission_stages(target_context)
13738 recorded_set = set(recorded_stages)
13739 selected_set = set(selected_stages)
13740 target_flag = "--run-dir" if target_context["target_kind"] == "run" else "--study-dir"
13741 target_path = os.path.relpath(target_context["root_dir"])
13742 submit_prefix = f"picurv submit {target_flag} {target_path}"
13743 solve_stage_command = (
13744 "picurv run --solve ... --no-submit"
13745 if target_context["target_kind"] == "run"
13746 else "picurv sweep --cluster <cluster.yml> ... --no-submit"
13747 )
13748 post_stage_command = (
13749 "picurv run --post-process --post <post.yml> ... --no-submit"
13750 if target_context["target_kind"] == "run"
13751 else "picurv sweep --cluster <cluster.yml> ... --no-submit"
13752 )
13753 solve_post_command = (
13754 "picurv run --solve --post-process --post <post.yml> ... --no-submit"
13755 if target_context["target_kind"] == "run"
13756 else "picurv sweep --cluster <cluster.yml> ... --no-submit"
13757 )
13758
13759 if requested_stage == "all":
13760 if recorded_set == {"solve"}:
13761 return (
13762 "--stage all requests solve and post-process, but this target records only solve. "
13763 f"Use `{submit_prefix} --stage solve`, or re-stage with post-processing enabled "
13764 f"(`{solve_post_command}`)."
13765 )
13766 if recorded_set == {"post-process"}:
13767 return (
13768 "--stage all requests solve and post-process, but this target records only post-process. "
13769 f"Use `{submit_prefix} --stage post-process`, or re-stage including the solve stage "
13770 f"(`{solve_stage_command}`)."
13771 )
13772 missing = [stage for stage in selected_stages if stage not in recorded_set]
13773 if missing:
13774 return (
13775 "--stage all requests solve and post-process, but submission metadata records "
13776 f"{_format_stage_list(recorded_stages)}. Re-stage the missing stage(s): "
13777 f"{_format_stage_list(missing)}."
13778 )
13779
13780 if selected_set == {"solve"} and "solve" not in recorded_set:
13781 return (
13782 "The solve stage was requested, but submission metadata does not record a staged solve command/script. "
13783 f"Re-stage with `{solve_stage_command}`."
13784 )
13785 if selected_set == {"post-process"} and "post-process" not in recorded_set:
13786 return (
13787 "The post-process stage was requested, but submission metadata does not record a staged post-process command/script. "
13788 f"Re-stage with post-processing enabled (`{post_stage_command}`, or `{solve_post_command}`)."
13789 )
13790
13791 return "Re-stage the requested stage(s) with picurv run/sweep --no-submit before calling picurv submit."
13792
13793
13794def _set_submission_stage_metadata(target_context: dict, stage_name: str, stage_meta: dict):
13795 """!
13796 @brief Persist one stage's metadata back into the submission payload.
13797 @param[in] target_context Argument passed to `_set_submission_stage_metadata()`.
13798 @param[in] stage_name Argument passed to `_set_submission_stage_metadata()`.
13799 @param[in] stage_meta Argument passed to `_set_submission_stage_metadata()`.
13800 """
13801 submission_meta = target_context["submission_meta"]
13802 if target_context["target_kind"] == "run":
13803 stages = submission_meta.get("stages")
13804 if not isinstance(stages, dict):
13805 stages = {}
13806 submission_meta["stages"] = stages
13807 stages[stage_name] = stage_meta
13808 return
13809
13810 key = "solver_array" if stage_name == "solve" else "post_array"
13811 submission_meta[key] = stage_meta
13812

13814def _write_submission_target_metadata(target_context: dict):
13815 """!
13816 @brief Write updated submission metadata back to disk.
13817 @param[in] target_context Argument passed to `_write_submission_target_metadata()`.
13818 """
13819 write_json_file(target_context["submission_path"], target_context["submission_meta"])
13820
13821 manifest_path = target_context.get("manifest_path")
13822 if manifest_path and os.path.isfile(manifest_path):
13823 manifest_payload = _read_json_if_exists(manifest_path)
13824 if isinstance(manifest_payload, dict):
13825 manifest_payload["submission"] = target_context["submission_meta"]
13826 write_json_file(manifest_path, manifest_payload)

13829def submit_staged_jobs(args):
13830 """!
13831 @brief Submit previously staged Slurm artifacts from an existing run/study directory.
13832 @param[in] args Command-line style argument list supplied to the function.
13833 """
13834 target_context = _resolve_submission_target(
13835 run_dir=getattr(args, "run_dir", None),
13836 study_dir=getattr(args, "study_dir", None),
13837 )
13838 stage_order = ["solve", "post-process"]
13839 requested_stage = args.stage
13840 selected_stages = stage_order if requested_stage == "all" else [requested_stage]
13841
13842 print(f"[INFO] {target_context['display_label']:<20}: {os.path.relpath(target_context['root_dir'])}")
13843 print(f"[INFO] Submission metadata : {os.path.relpath(target_context['submission_path'])}")
13844 print(f"[INFO] Requested stages : {', '.join(selected_stages)}")
13845
13846 if target_context.get("launch_mode") == "local":
13847 submit_staged_local_run(args, target_context, selected_stages)
13848 return
13849
13850 stage_plans = []
13851 solve_existing_meta = _get_submission_stage_metadata(target_context, "solve")
13852 solve_existing_job_id = str(solve_existing_meta.get("job_id", "")).strip()
13853
13854 for stage_name in selected_stages:
13855 existing_meta = _get_submission_stage_metadata(target_context, stage_name)
13856 script_path = target_context["script_map"][stage_name]
13857 missing_stage_hint = _build_submit_missing_stage_hint(target_context, requested_stage, selected_stages)
13858 if not existing_meta:
13859 emit_structured_error(
13860 ERROR_CODE_CFG_MISSING_KEY,
13861 key=f"scheduler.{stage_name}.metadata",
13862 file_path=target_context["submission_path"],
13863 message=f"Submission metadata does not record stage '{stage_name}'.",
13864 hint=missing_stage_hint,
13865 )
13866 sys.exit(1)
13867
13868 if not os.path.isfile(script_path):
13869 emit_structured_error(
13870 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
13871 key=f"scheduler.{stage_name}.script",
13872 file_path=script_path,
13873 message=f"Required {stage_name} sbatch artifact is missing.",
13874 hint=missing_stage_hint,
13875 )
13876 sys.exit(1)
13877
13878 if existing_meta.get("submitted") and not args.force:
13879 emit_structured_error(
13880 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
13881 key=f"scheduler.{stage_name}.submitted",
13882 file_path=target_context["submission_path"],
13883 message=f"Stage '{stage_name}' is already recorded as submitted.",
13884 hint="Use --force to resubmit this stage intentionally.",
13885 )
13886 sys.exit(1)
13887
13888 dependency = None
13889 if stage_name == "post-process":
13890 if "solve" in selected_stages:
13891 dependency = "__NEW_SOLVE_JOB_ID__"
13892 else:
13893 if not (solve_existing_meta.get("submitted") and solve_existing_job_id):
13894 emit_structured_error(
13895 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
13896 key="scheduler.post-process.dependency",
13897 file_path=target_context["submission_path"],
13898 message="Post-process submission requires a recorded solve job id when solve is not being submitted in the same command.",
13899 hint="Submit --stage solve or --stage all first, or use --force only after solve metadata exists.",
13900 )
13901 sys.exit(1)
13902 dependency = solve_existing_job_id
13903
13904 stage_plans.append(
13905 {
13906 "stage": stage_name,
13907 "script": script_path,
13908 "dependency": dependency,
13909 "existing_meta": existing_meta,
13910 }
13911 )
13912
13913 if args.dry_run:
13914 for plan in stage_plans:
13915 cmd = ["sbatch"]
13916 dependency = plan["dependency"]
13917 if dependency == "__NEW_SOLVE_JOB_ID__":
13918 cmd.append("--dependency=afterok:<new solve job id>")
13919 elif dependency:
13920 cmd.append(f"--dependency=afterok:{dependency}")
13921 cmd.append(plan["script"])
13922 print(f"[DRY-RUN] Would run: {' '.join(cmd)}")
13923 print("[INFO] Dry-run only. No jobs were submitted.")
13924 return
13925
13926 latest_solve_job_id = None
13927 for plan in stage_plans:
13928 dependency = plan["dependency"]
13929 if dependency == "__NEW_SOLVE_JOB_ID__":
13930 dependency = latest_solve_job_id
13931
13932 submit_info = submit_sbatch(plan["script"], dependency=dependency)
13933 stage_meta = copy.deepcopy(plan["existing_meta"])
13934 stage_meta.update(submit_info)
13935 stage_meta["script"] = plan["script"]
13936 stage_meta["submitted"] = True
13937 if dependency:
13938 stage_meta["dependency"] = f"afterok:{dependency}"
13939 else:
13940 stage_meta.pop("dependency", None)
13941
13942 _set_submission_stage_metadata(target_context, plan["stage"], stage_meta)
13943 print(f"[SUCCESS] Submitted {plan['stage']} job: {submit_info['job_id']}")
13944
13945 if plan["stage"] == "solve":
13946 latest_solve_job_id = submit_info["job_id"]
13947
13948 _write_submission_target_metadata(target_context)
13949
13950
13951def submit_staged_local_run(args, target_context: dict, selected_stages: list):
13952 """!
13953 @brief Execute previously staged local run commands from scheduler/submission.json.
13954 @param[in] args Command-line style argument list supplied to the function.
13955 @param[in] target_context Resolved submission target context.
13956 @param[in] selected_stages Ordered stage names selected by the user.
13957 """
13958 if target_context["target_kind"] != "run":
13959 emit_structured_error(
13960 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
13961 key="scheduler.launch_mode",
13962 file_path=target_context["submission_path"],
13963 message="Local staged execution is supported for run directories only.",
13964 hint="Use --run-dir for local staged execution.",
13965 )
13966 sys.exit(1)
13967
13968 stage_plans = []
13969 solve_existing_meta = _get_submission_stage_metadata(target_context, "solve")
13970 solve_already_done = bool(solve_existing_meta.get("submitted") or solve_existing_meta.get("executed"))
13971
13972 for stage_name in selected_stages:
13973 existing_meta = _get_submission_stage_metadata(target_context, stage_name)
13974 command = existing_meta.get("command")
13975 if not isinstance(command, list) or not command:
13976 if existing_meta:
13977 hint = "Re-stage the run with picurv run --no-submit before calling picurv submit."
13978 else:
13979 hint = _build_submit_missing_stage_hint(target_context, args.stage, selected_stages)
13980 emit_structured_error(
13981 ERROR_CODE_CFG_MISSING_KEY,
13982 key=f"scheduler.{stage_name}.command",
13983 file_path=target_context["submission_path"],
13984 message=f"Required local command metadata for stage '{stage_name}' is missing.",
13985 hint=hint,
13986 )
13987 sys.exit(1)
13988
13989 if existing_meta.get("submitted") and not args.force:
13990 emit_structured_error(
13991 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
13992 key=f"scheduler.{stage_name}.submitted",
13993 file_path=target_context["submission_path"],
13994 message=f"Stage '{stage_name}' is already recorded as submitted.",
13995 hint="Use --force to execute this stage again intentionally.",
13996 )
13997 sys.exit(1)
13998
13999 if stage_name == "post-process" and "solve" not in selected_stages and not args.force and not solve_already_done:
14000 emit_structured_error(
14001 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
14002 key="scheduler.post-process.dependency",
14003 file_path=target_context["submission_path"],
14004 message="Post-process local execution requires a recorded completed solve stage when solve is not being executed in the same command.",
14005 hint="Submit --stage solve or --stage all first, or use --force after confirming source data exists.",
14006 )
14007 sys.exit(1)
14008
14009 log_file = existing_meta.get("log_file")
14010 if not isinstance(log_file, str) or not log_file.strip():
14011 log_file = os.path.join("scheduler", f"{os.path.basename(target_context['root_dir'])}_{stage_name}.log")
14012
14013 stage_plans.append(
14014 {
14015 "stage": stage_name,
14016 "command": [str(token) for token in command],
14017 "log_file": log_file,
14018 "existing_meta": existing_meta,
14019 }
14020 )
14021
14022 if args.dry_run:
14023 for plan in stage_plans:
14024 print(f"[DRY-RUN] Would run: {format_command_for_display(plan['command'])}")
14025 print(f"[DRY-RUN] Log file : {plan['log_file']}")
14026 print("[INFO] Dry-run only. No local commands were executed.")
14027 return
14028
14029 monitor_cfg = None
14030 monitor_path = os.path.join(target_context["root_dir"], "config", "monitor.yml")
14031 if os.path.isfile(monitor_path):
14032 monitor_cfg = read_yaml_file(monitor_path)
14033
14034 for plan in stage_plans:
14035 execute_command(plan["command"], target_context["root_dir"], plan["log_file"], monitor_cfg)
14036 stage_meta = copy.deepcopy(plan["existing_meta"])
14037 stage_meta["command"] = plan["command"]
14038 stage_meta["command_string"] = format_command_for_display(plan["command"])
14039 stage_meta["log_file"] = plan["log_file"]
14040 stage_meta["submitted"] = True
14041 stage_meta["executed"] = True
14042 stage_meta["completed_at"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
14043 _set_submission_stage_metadata(target_context, plan["stage"], stage_meta)
14044 print(f"[SUCCESS] Executed local {plan['stage']} stage.")
14045
14046 _write_submission_target_metadata(target_context)
14047
14048
14049def cancel_run_jobs(args):
14050 """!
14051 @brief Cancel Slurm-submitted jobs for an existing run directory.
14052 @param[in] args Command-line style argument list supplied to the function.
14053 """
14054 run_dir = os.path.abspath(args.run_dir)
14055 if not os.path.isdir(run_dir):
14056 emit_structured_error(
14057 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
14058 key="run_dir",
14059 file_path=run_dir,
14060 message="Run directory not found.",
14061 )
14062 sys.exit(1)
14063
14064 submission_path = os.path.join(run_dir, "scheduler", "submission.json")
14065 submission_meta = _read_json_if_exists(submission_path)
14066 if not isinstance(submission_meta, dict):
14067 emit_structured_error(
14068 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
14069 key="scheduler.submission",
14070 file_path=submission_path,
14071 message="Run directory does not contain scheduler submission metadata.",
14072 hint="Use a Slurm-submitted run directory with scheduler/submission.json, or cancel the job manually.",
14073 )
14074 sys.exit(1)
14075
14076 launch_mode = str(submission_meta.get("launch_mode", "")).lower()
14077 if launch_mode != "slurm":
14078 emit_structured_error(
14079 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
14080 key="scheduler.launch_mode",
14081 file_path=submission_path,
14082 message=f"Run directory launch_mode={launch_mode or 'unknown'} is not Slurm.",
14083 hint="picurv cancel currently supports Slurm-submitted runs only.",
14084 )
14085 sys.exit(1)
14086
14087 stage_order = ["solve", "post-process"]
14088 requested_stage = args.stage
14089 selected_stages = stage_order if requested_stage == "all" else [requested_stage]
14090 recorded_stages = submission_meta.get("stages", {})
14091 if not isinstance(recorded_stages, dict):
14092 recorded_stages = {}
14093
14094 job_to_stages = {}
14095 skipped = []
14096 for stage_name in selected_stages:
14097 stage_meta = recorded_stages.get(stage_name)
14098 if not isinstance(stage_meta, dict):
14099 skipped.append((stage_name, "no stage metadata recorded"))
14100 continue
14101
14102 job_id = str(stage_meta.get("job_id", "")).strip()
14103 if not stage_meta.get("submitted"):
14104 skipped.append((stage_name, "job was generated but not submitted"))
14105 continue
14106 if not job_id:
14107 skipped.append((stage_name, "submitted stage is missing a recorded job id"))
14108 continue
14109
14110 job_to_stages.setdefault(job_id, []).append(stage_name)
14111
14112 if not job_to_stages:
14113 print(f"[INFO] Run directory : {os.path.relpath(run_dir)}")
14114 print(f"[INFO] Submission metadata: {os.path.relpath(submission_path)}")
14115 for stage_name, reason in skipped:
14116 print(f"[INFO] Skipping stage '{stage_name}': {reason}")
14117 print("[FATAL] No submitted Slurm job IDs were found for the requested stage selection.", file=sys.stderr)
14118 sys.exit(1)
14119
14120 print(f"[INFO] Run directory : {os.path.relpath(run_dir)}")
14121 print(f"[INFO] Submission metadata: {os.path.relpath(submission_path)}")
14122 print(f"[INFO] Requested stages : {', '.join(selected_stages)}")
14123
14124 if skipped:
14125 for stage_name, reason in skipped:
14126 print(f"[INFO] Skipping stage '{stage_name}': {reason}")
14127
14128 graceful = bool(getattr(args, "graceful", False))
14129 failures = []
14130 for job_id, stage_names in job_to_stages.items():
14131 joined_stage_names = ", ".join(stage_names)
14132 use_graceful_signal = graceful and "solve" in stage_names
14133 scancel_cmd = ["scancel"]
14134 if use_graceful_signal:
14135 scancel_cmd.append("--signal=USR1")
14136 scancel_cmd.append(job_id)
14137
14138 if args.dry_run:
14139 print(f"[DRY-RUN] Would run: {' '.join(scancel_cmd)} # stage(s): {joined_stage_names}")
14140 continue
14141
14142 result = subprocess.run(scancel_cmd, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
14143 stderr_text = (result.stderr or "").strip()
14144 stdout_text = (result.stdout or "").strip()
14145 if result.returncode == 0:
14146 if use_graceful_signal:
14147 print(
14148 f"[SUCCESS] Requested graceful shutdown for Slurm job {job_id} for stage(s): {joined_stage_names}. "
14149 "Solver jobs trap SIGUSR1 and write the latest safe off-cadence step at the next checkpoint."
14150 )
14151 else:
14152 print(f"[SUCCESS] Canceled Slurm job {job_id} for stage(s): {joined_stage_names}")
14153 continue
14154
14155 detail = stderr_text or stdout_text or "unknown scancel failure"
14156 failures.append((job_id, joined_stage_names, detail, result.returncode))
14157 print(
14158 f"[ERROR] Failed to cancel Slurm job {job_id} for stage(s) {joined_stage_names}: {detail}",
14159 file=sys.stderr,
14160 )
14161
14162 if args.dry_run:
14163 print("[INFO] Dry-run only. No jobs were canceled.")
14164 return
14165
14166 if failures:
14167 sys.exit(1)
14168
14169
14170def init_case(args):
14171 """!
14172 @brief Implements the 'init' command.
14173 @details Creates a new case study directory by copying a template.
14174 Runtime binaries are resolved from the project bin/ directory
14175 via PATH; use 'sync-binaries' to pin specific versions locally.
14176 @param[in] args The command-line arguments parsed by argparse.
14177 """
14178 context = resolve_case_origin_context(source_root_override=getattr(args, "source_root", None))
14179 try:
14180 source_project_root = require_project_root(context["source_project_root"], "init")
14181 template_path = resolve_template_directory(source_project_root, args.template_name)
14182 except ValueError as exc:
14183 print(f"[FATAL] {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
14184 sys.exit(1)
14185
14186 # The destination path is relative to the current working directory.
14187 dest_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), args.dest_name if args.dest_name else args.template_name))
14188
14189 if os.path.exists(dest_path):
14190 print(f"[FATAL] Destination directory '{dest_path}' already exists.", file=sys.stderr)
14191 sys.exit(1)
14192
14193 print(f"[INFO] Initializing new case '{os.path.basename(dest_path)}' from template '{args.template_name}'...")
14194
14195 shutil.copytree(template_path, dest_path)
14196 print(f"[SUCCESS] Copied template files to: {dest_path}")
14197
14198 copied_runtime_example = os.path.join(dest_path, RUNTIME_EXECUTION_EXAMPLE_FILENAME)
14199 if os.path.isfile(copied_runtime_example):
14200 os.remove(copied_runtime_example)
14201
14202 try:
14203 runtime_result = ensure_case_runtime_execution_config(dest_path, source_project_root, overwrite=True)
14204 print(f"[INFO] Wrote optional runtime launcher config: {os.path.relpath(runtime_result['path'])}")
14205 if runtime_result["seed_source"] and os.path.basename(runtime_result["seed_source"]) == RUNTIME_EXECUTION_CONFIG_FILENAME:
14206 print(" Seeded from repo-local '.picurv-execution.yml'.")
14207 print(" Leave it unchanged for ordinary local runs; edit it only if your site needs custom MPI launcher tokens.")
14208 except Exception as e:
14209 print(f"[ERROR] Failed to write runtime execution config: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
14210
14211 try:
14212 metadata_path, _ = write_case_origin_metadata(
14213 dest_path,
14214 source_project_root,
14215 template_name=args.template_name,
14216 template_managed_files=list_template_relative_files(
14217 template_path,
14218 excluded_rel_paths={RUNTIME_EXECUTION_EXAMPLE_FILENAME},
14219 ),
14220 )
14221 print(f"[INFO] Wrote case origin metadata: {os.path.relpath(metadata_path)}")
14222 except Exception as e:
14223 print(f"[ERROR] Failed to write case origin metadata: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
14224
14225 cluster_profile_candidates = sorted(
14226 {
14227 os.path.basename(path)
14228 for pattern in ("*cluster*.yml", "*cluster*.yaml")
14229 for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(dest_path, pattern))
14230 }
14231 )
14232 if cluster_profile_candidates:
14233 print("[INFO] Cluster profile sample(s) copied with this case:")
14234 for profile_name in cluster_profile_candidates:
14235 print(f" - {profile_name}")
14236 print(" Edit account/partition/module_setup and any batch-specific launcher overrides before using --cluster.")
14237
14238 if getattr(args, "pin_binaries", False):
14239 print("[INFO] Pinning runtime binaries into case directory...")
14240 try:
14241 copied_binaries = sync_case_binaries(dest_path, source_project_root)
14242 for dest_file_path in copied_binaries:
14243 print(f" - Pinned '{os.path.basename(dest_file_path)}'")
14244 print("[SUCCESS] Case directory is ready with pinned binaries.")
14245 print(" These local copies will be used instead of bin/ originals.")
14246 except ValueError as exc:
14247 print(f"[WARNING] {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
14248 print(" No binaries were pinned. Run 'picurv build' first.", file=sys.stderr)
14249 else:
14250 print("[SUCCESS] Case directory is ready.")
14251 print(" Runtime binaries (simulator, postprocessor) are resolved from bin/ automatically.")
14252 print(" To pin specific binary versions, re-run with --pin-binaries or use: picurv sync-binaries")
14253 print(" Ensure 'picurv' is on your PATH (source etc/picurv.sh) to run from any directory.")
14254
14255
14256def sync_case_binaries_command(args):
14257 """!
14258 @brief Refresh case-local executables from the source repository bin directory.
14259 @param[in] args Command-line style argument list supplied to the function.
14260 """
14261 try:
14262 context = resolve_case_origin_context(
14263 case_dir_hint=getattr(args, "case_dir", None),
14264 source_root_override=getattr(args, "source_root", None),
14265 )
14266 source_project_root = require_project_root(context["source_project_root"], "sync-binaries")
14267 case_dir = require_existing_case_dir(context["case_dir"], "sync-binaries", source_project_root)
14268 copied = sync_case_binaries(case_dir, source_project_root)
14269 metadata_path, metadata = write_case_origin_metadata(
14270 case_dir,
14271 source_project_root,
14272 template_name=context.get("template_name"),
14273 existing=context.get("metadata"),
14274 )
14275 except ValueError as exc:
14276 print(f"[FATAL] {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
14277 sys.exit(1)
14278
14279 print(f"[SUCCESS] Refreshed {len(copied)} binaries in: {case_dir}")
14280 for dest_path in copied:
14281 print(f" - {os.path.basename(dest_path)}")
14282 print(f"[INFO] Case origin metadata refreshed: {os.path.relpath(metadata_path)}")

14287def sync_case_config_command(args):
14288 """!
14289 @brief Refresh template-managed config/docs files in a case directory.
14290 @param[in] args Command-line style argument list supplied to the function.
14291 """
14292 try:
14293 context = resolve_case_origin_context(
14294 case_dir_hint=getattr(args, "case_dir", None),
14295 source_root_override=getattr(args, "source_root", None),
14296 template_name_override=getattr(args, "template_name", None),
14297 )
14298 source_project_root = require_project_root(context["source_project_root"], "sync-config")
14299 case_dir = require_existing_case_dir(context["case_dir"], "sync-config", source_project_root)
14300 template_name = context.get("template_name")
14301 template_dir = resolve_template_directory(source_project_root, template_name)
14302 existing_managed = context.get("metadata", {}).get("template_managed_files")
14303 if not isinstance(existing_managed, list):
14304 existing_managed = None
14305 summary = sync_case_template_files(
14306 case_dir,
14307 template_dir,
14308 overwrite=getattr(args, "overwrite", False),
14309 prune=getattr(args, "prune", False),
14310 managed_rel_paths=existing_managed,
14311 )
14312 metadata_path, _ = write_case_origin_metadata(
14313 case_dir,
14314 source_project_root,
14315 template_name=template_name,
14316 existing=context.get("metadata"),
14317 template_managed_files=summary["template_managed_files"],
14318 )
14319 runtime_result = ensure_case_runtime_execution_config(case_dir, source_project_root, overwrite=False)
14320 except ValueError as exc:
14321 print(f"[FATAL] {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
14322 sys.exit(1)
14323
14324 print(f"[SUCCESS] Synced template files from '{template_name}' into: {case_dir}")
14325 print(f"[INFO] Copied new files : {len(summary['copied'])}")
14326 print(f"[INFO] Overwritten files : {len(summary['overwritten'])}")
14327 print(f"[INFO] Skipped modified : {len(summary['skipped_modified'])}")
14328 print(f"[INFO] Already unchanged : {len(summary['unchanged'])}")
14329 print(f"[INFO] Pruned stale files : {len(summary['pruned'])}")
14330 if runtime_result["created"]:
14331 print(f"[INFO] Created runtime launcher config: {os.path.relpath(runtime_result['path'])}")
14332 if runtime_result["seed_source"] and os.path.basename(runtime_result["seed_source"]) == RUNTIME_EXECUTION_CONFIG_FILENAME:
14333 print("[INFO] Seed source : repo-local .picurv-execution.yml")
14334 if summary.get("prune_requested_without_tracking"):
14335 print("[WARNING] Prune tracking unavailable for this case; no removed template files were deleted.", file=sys.stderr)
14336 print(f"[INFO] Case origin metadata refreshed: {os.path.relpath(metadata_path)}")
14337

14339def pull_source_repo(args):
14340 """!
14341 @brief Refresh source branches in the repository resolved from a case directory.
14342 @param[in] args Command-line style argument list supplied to the function.
14343 """
14344 try:
14345 context = resolve_case_origin_context(
14346 case_dir_hint=getattr(args, "case_dir", None),
14347 source_root_override=getattr(args, "source_root", None),
14348 )
14349 source_project_root = require_project_root(context["source_project_root"], "pull-source")
14350 except ValueError as exc:
14351 print(f"[FATAL] {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
14352 sys.exit(1)
14353
14354 rebase = not getattr(args, "no_rebase", False)
14355 remote = getattr(args, "remote", None)
14356 branch = getattr(args, "branch", None)
14357 current_branch_only = (
14358 getattr(args, "current_branch_only", False)
14359 or remote is not None
14360 or branch is not None
14361 )
14362
14363 if not current_branch_only:
14364 pull_all_source_branches(source_project_root, "pull-source.log", rebase=rebase)
14365 return
14366
14367 command = ["git", "pull"]
14368 if rebase:
14369 command.append("--rebase")
14370 if remote:
14371 command.append(remote)
14372 if branch:
14373 command.append(branch)
14374 elif branch:
14375 command.extend(["origin", branch])
14376
14377 execute_command(command, source_project_root, "pull-source.log", {})

14379def build_project(args):
14380 """!
14381 @brief Implements the 'build' command.
14382 @details Executes the top-level Makefile directly, passing through any
14383 additional arguments to `make`. This allows for building,
14384 cleaning, and other Makefile targets via the orchestrator
14385 without maintaining a separate build wrapper script.
14386 @param[in] args The command-line arguments parsed by argparse.
14387 """
14388
14389 print("\n" + "="*27 + " BUILD STAGE " + "="*27)
14390 try:
14391 context = resolve_case_origin_context(
14392 case_dir_hint=getattr(args, "case_dir", None),
14393 source_root_override=getattr(args, "source_root", None),
14394 )
14395 source_project_root = require_project_root(context["source_project_root"], "build")
14396 except ValueError as exc:
14397 print(f"[FATAL] {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
14398 sys.exit(1)
14399
14400 makefile_path = os.path.join(source_project_root, "Makefile")
14401
14402 if not os.path.isfile(makefile_path):
14403 print(f"[FATAL] Makefile not found at expected location: {makefile_path}", file=sys.stderr)
14404 print(" Please ensure the project root contains a valid Makefile.", file=sys.stderr)
14405 sys.exit(1)
14406
14407 make_args = list(args.make_args or [])
14408 if make_args_include_explicit_goal(make_args):
14409 command = ["make"] + make_args
14410 else:
14411 command = ["make", "all"] + make_args
14412 print("[INFO] No explicit make target supplied; defaulting to 'all'.")
14413 print(" Use 'picurv build clean-project ...' or another target when you want a non-build make action.")
14414 # For the build process, we don't have a monitor.yml, so we pass an empty
14415 # dict to execute_command. The command should be run in the project root.
14416 execute_command(command, source_project_root, "build.log", {})
